name: std::swap(std::basic_ofstream)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT, class Traits>

void swap(basic_ofstream<CharT, Traits> &lhs, basic_ofstream<CharT, Traits> &rhs);

intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::basic_ofstream. Exchanges the state of lhs with that of rhs. Effectively calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs
